Reauth_Message: Enter your master password to continue.
About_Body: Password manager and form filler for Windows. Your data is encrypted and stays on this PC.
About_Licenses: Passphrases use the EFF Large Wordlist (CC-BY 3.0); domain matching uses the Public Suffix List (MPL-2.0).
Login_NoVault: No vault exists yet. Please run setup first.
Setup_Welcome_Body: TKRForm stores your passwords and fills forms for you. First, choose the master password that protects your vault.
Setup_Welcome_Point1: Your data is encrypted and never leaves this PC.
Setup_Welcome_Point2: The master password is not stored. If you forget it, it cannot be recovered.
Setup_Storage_LocalDesc: Store data on this PC only.
Setup_MP_Body: A long passphrase that you do not use anywhere else works best.
Setup_MP_Mismatch: The two entries do not match.
Setup_MP_Weak: Strength is below 50 bits. Make it longer, or tick "Use it anyway".
Setup_MP_IterationsNote: More iterations resist brute force better but make unlocking slower.
Setup_Hint_Warn: The hint is stored unencrypted. Do not write the password itself or anything easy to guess.
Setup_Ext_Step1: Open the extensions page in Chrome or Edge and turn on "Developer mode".
Setup_Ext_Step2: Click "Load unpacked" and choose the folder shown below.
Setup_Ext_Step3: Click the TKRForm icon in the toolbar and check that you can unlock.
Setup_Ext_PathMissing: The extension folder was not found. Choose the "extension" folder in the install directory.
Setup_Ext_Note: The connection to TKRForm is registered automatically. No browser restart is needed after loading the extension.
Setup_Import_Body: You can import files from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Bitwarden or generic CSV. You can also do this later.
Import_Format_generic: Format: generic CSV (check the column mapping)
Import_SkipDup: Skip items whose URL and user ID already exist
Import_FolderNote: Imported items go into an "Import <date>" folder.
Export_PlainWarning: CSV and JSON are written as unprotected files. Be careful where you keep them and how you dispose of them. Passkey private keys are not included in CSV or JSON (they are included in the encrypted .tkb backup).
Export_Reauth: Enter your master password to write unprotected data.
Print_Warning: Keep printouts somewhere safe and shred them when no longer needed.

Sec_ScoreBody: Checked %1 logins. The fewer weak, reused or old passwords, the higher the score.
Sec_Desc_Weak: Passwords with a strength under 50 bits. Make them longer and use more kinds of characters.
Sec_Desc_Reused: The same password is used by two or more logins. If one leaks, the others are at risk too.
Sec_Desc_Old: Logins whose password has not changed for 365 days or more.
Sec_Desc_Dups: Two or more logins have the same URL and user ID.
Sec_Desc_Breach: Checks whether your saved passwords appear in known leaks.
Sec_GroupDup: Same URL and user ID (%1 logins)
Sec_Corrupt: %1 corrupted items were not included in the check.
Sec_BreachOff: Breach check is off. When on, it checks whether your saved passwords appear in known leaks.
Sec_BreachConsentBody:
This feature queries the Have I Been Pwned (Pwned Passwords) service.

- Your passwords are never sent. Only the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash are sent, and the matching is done on this PC (k-anonymity).
- Which item a hash belongs to is not sent.
- Destination: api.pwnedpasswords.com (https)

Turn it on? You can turn it off at any time.

Hello_On: You can unlock with Windows Hello.

Hello_Note: When on, you can unlock with a Windows Hello check (PIN, face or fingerprint) instead of the master password. Turn it on again after changing the master password.
Hello_DisableConfirm: Stop unlocking with Windows Hello? The registered credential and this vault's hello.key are deleted. You can still unlock with the master password.

Pref_general_updateUrl_Hint: When empty, latest.json next to the sync server is used. Without a sync server, no check is made.

Reset_Warn:
This deletes ALL TKRForm data:

- the vault (all logins, profiles, notes, ...)
- settings, the sync connection and the Windows Hello registration

Backups (the default folder and any folder you chose) are NOT deleted. You can restore from them after the reset.

Deleted data cannot be recovered otherwise.
